Comment.value: IGNORE THIS STARTING CONDITION.
Henchman joins party.  He takes away the personal items of all other henchmen.  He gives the player his own personal item (which he creates) (Daelanpersonal).  Set DaelanWork to 1.

This starting condition should only come up if the henchman is working for a player and it is NOT that player who is trying to talk to him (the script NW_CH_JOIN_NOT only checks to see if the henchman is working for ANY player, including the one he is currently serving).

DaelanWork is 1.  This comes up if the player has dropped the NPC from his party.  The NPC remains where he is standing until the player returns.  The NPC will NOT join with another Player, only his current owner.
He joins and takes any other personal items away from the player (except his personal item).

DaelanWork is 1. This starting condition shows up if Daelan was killed.  The player needs to have the item 'daelanpersonal'.  If the player doesn't have this, then Daelan will simply treat the player like any other player (probably his second time talked to dialogue).
He joins and takes any other personal items away from the player (except his personal item).
DaelanC3greet is 1.  DaelanWork is 0. Default greeting in chapter 3 (the player has already talked to him once).

DaelanC3greet is 0.  DaelanWork is 0.  Initial greeting.  When the player first meets him in chapter 3.  Set DaelanC3greet to 1.  Do this later on in the dialogue, about 3 dialogue nodes in (I have marked those as well).   The player doesn't have the henchman's personal item (daelanpersonal).
